blocks.zh: 一项关于同伴身体质量指数（BMI）的研究

blocks.en: Heavier peers increase body mass index (BMI) by 0.83 units.
blocks.zh: 体重更重的同伴会使身体质量指数增加 0.83 个单位。

blocks.en: This effect is not spurious. Because beta times n minus one is always one, beta equals negative n minus one, which is negative.
blocks.zh: 该效应并非虚假。表明因为 −β(n−1) 恒为 1，故 β = −(n −1) < 0。

blocks.en: Because beta times n minus one is always one, beta equals negative n minus one.
blocks.zh: 因为 −β(n−1) 恒等于 1，所以 β = −(n −1) < 0。
